pipelines..github/workflows/hb_electronics-pipelin:
name: hb_electronics CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/**
      - .github/workflows/hb_electronics.yml
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/**
      - .github/workflows/hb_electronics.yml

env:
  SERVICE_PATH: gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics
  REGISTRY_HOST: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_HOST }}
  REGISTRY_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
  REGISTRY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}
  IMAGE_TAG: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_HOST }}/${{ github.repository }}/hb_electronics:${{ github.sha }}
  ENABLE_DEPLOY: ${{ vars.ENABLE_DEPLOY }}

jobs:
  test:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ env.SERVICE_PATH }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ env.SERVICE_PATH }}/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test -- --watch=false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ env.SERVICE_PATH }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ env.SERVICE_PATH }}/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build application
        run: npm run build
      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-dist
          path: ${{ env.SERVICE_PATH }}/dist
          retention-days: 1

  package:
    name: Package
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      dockerfile_exists: ${{ steps.check_dockerfile.outputs.exists }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ env.SERVICE_PATH }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Download build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-dist
          path: ${{ env.SERVICE_PATH }}/dist
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ env.SERVICE_PATH }}/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Create package tarball
        run: npm pack
      - name: Upload package tarball
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: package-tgz
          path: ${{ env.SERVICE_PATH }}/*.tgz
          retention-days: 1
      - name: Check Dockerfile exists
        id: check_dockerfile
        run: |
          if [ -f Dockerfile ]; then
            echo "exists=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "exists=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        if: steps.check_dockerfile.outputs.exists == 'true'
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - name: Login to Container Registry
        if: steps.check_dockerfile.outputs.exists == 'true'
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}
          username: ${{ env.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ env.REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}
      - name: Build and Push Docker Image
        if: steps.check_dockerfile.outputs.exists == 'true'
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ${{ env.SERVICE_PATH }}
          push: true
          tags: ${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  upload_artifact:
    name: Upload Artifact
    needs: package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      dockerfile_exists: ${{ needs.package.outputs.dockerfile_exists }}
    steps:
      - name: Download build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-dist
          path: dist
      - name: Download package artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: package-tgz
          path: .
      - name: Upload final artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: hb_electronics-artifacts
          path: |
            dist/**
            *.tgz
          retention-days: 30

  security_scan:
    name: Security Scan
    needs: upload_artifact
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: needs.upload_artifact.outputs.dockerfile_exists == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: ${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}
          format: 'table'
          exit-code: '1'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'

  deploy:
    name: Deploy
    needs: security_scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && env.ENABLE_DEPLOY == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to environment
        run: |
          echo 'Example deploy: kubectl apply -f k8s/'
          echo 'Example deploy: helm upgrade --install app ./chart'
pipelines..github/workflows/gestiondestock-pipelin:
name: gestiondestock CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'gestion_stock/gestiondestock/**'
      - '.github/workflows/gestiondestock.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'gestion_stock/gestiondestock/**'

env:
  WORKING_DIR: gestion_stock/gestiondestock
  REGISTRY_HOST: ${{ vars.REGISTRY_HOST || 'docker.io' }}
  REGISTRY_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
  REGISTRY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}
  IMAGE_NAME: gestiondestock
  IMAGE_TAG: ${{ vars.IMAGE_TAG || github.sha }}
  ENABLE_DEPLOY: ${{ vars.ENABLE_DEPLOY || 'false' }}

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'corretto'
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Run unit tests
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
        run: mvn -B test

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'corretto'
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Build project
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
        run: mvn -B -DskipTests clean compile

  package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'corretto'
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: Package application
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
        run: mvn -B -DskipTests package
      - name: Upload JAR artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gestiondestock-jar
          path: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}/target/*.jar
          retention-days: 5

  upload_artifact:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: package
    outputs:
      docker_built: ${{ steps.check_docker.outputs.exists }}
      image_fqn: ${{ steps.image.outputs.fqn }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Download JAR artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gestiondestock-jar
          path: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}/target/
      - name: Check for Dockerfile
        id: check_docker
        run: |
          if [ -f "${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}/Dockerfile" ]; then
            echo "exists=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "exists=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "No Dockerfile found, skipping Docker build"
          fi
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        if: steps.check_docker.outputs.exists == 'true'
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - name: Login to Container Registry
        if: steps.check_docker.outputs.exists == 'true' && env.REGISTRY_USERNAME != ''
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}
          username: ${{ env.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ env.REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}
      - name: Build and push Docker image
        if: steps.check_docker.outputs.exists == 'true' && env.REGISTRY_USERNAME != ''
        id: docker_build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
          push: true
          tags: ${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
      - name: Set image output
        if: steps.check_docker.outputs.exists == 'true'
        id: image
        run: |
          echo "fqn=${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  security_scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: upload_artifact
    if: needs.upload_artifact.outputs.docker_built == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: ${{ needs.upload_artifact.outputs.image_fqn }}
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-results.sarif'
          exit-code: '1'
          ignore-unfixed: true
          severity: 'HIGH,CRITICAL'
      - name: Upload Trivy scan results
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        if: always()
        with:
          sarif_file: 'trivy-results.sarif'

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: security_scan
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && env.ENABLE_DEPLOY == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Download JAR artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gestiondestock-jar
          path: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}/target/
      - name: Deploy application
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
        run: |
          echo "Deploying gestiondestock..."
          echo "Example deploy: java -jar target/*.jar"
          echo "Example deploy: kubectl rollout restart deployment/backend"
          # Actual deployment commands would go here
          # java -jar target/gestiondestock-*.jar --spring.profiles.active=prod &
